title: Recipe F: E + MixUp/CutMix (p=0.5) + EMA 0.999, 300 epochs
hypothesis: MixUp/CutMix and EMA should regularise the from-scratch model and close the validation-to-test gap.

results.name: mean of 5 fold scores
results.note: reported as mean of folds, not pooled OOF

findings: On validation, F beats E by about +0.10 (0.727 vs 0.627 mean).
Public score rose from 0.519 (E, one fold) to 0.677 (F, five folds).
limitations: Validation still lacks rotation; this was the main gap found later.
Mean-of-folds number, not pooled OOF, so it is not strictly comparable with scene5 OOF.

evidence.code: Notebook dateraquest.ipynb (not hashed). Same augmentation module dq.py.
